walkthroughs.body_html: Robotic probes can endure radiation, vacuum and long travel times that humans cannot. They return data on atmospheres, surfaces and magnetic fields, often using gravity assists to save fuel.
Inner planets are small, dense and rocky with thin or no atmospheres. Outer planets are huge, low-density gas/ice giants with thick hydrogen-rich atmospheres, rings and many moons.

For 'describe and explain' questions: 1) state the fact, 2) give evidence, 3) link to a process or mission. Example: Voyager 1 confirmed the heliopause in 2012 by measuring a sudden change in particle density.
